verdict.rationale: A business-filing authority could plausibly document statutory or registered agents or authorized filers, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a sanctioned third-party rail. The only nearby item mentions 'Filing Administrator functions' in the Ohio Business Gateway, an internal account-administration role on a separate state portal rather than a documented designee or authorized-provider mechanism. The SOS's own sites returned 403 at robots.txt, so nothing first-party was retrieved.
